english.title: Keeper of pig vaccinated against classical swine fever that is slaughtered other than at designated slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a keeper who had

(A)_[a pig]_
(B)_[pigs]_

vaccinated against classical swine fever, had

(C)_[it]_
(D)_[them]_

slaughtered at a place other than at a designated slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE OF SLAUGHTER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(3) and 39(1)(k) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a keeper who had a pig / pigs vaccinated against classical swine fever
had it / them slaughtered other than at a designated slaughterhouse

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence no longer applies after 28th April 2026, due to changes made by the Exotic Animal Disease (Amendment) (England) Order 2026 (SI 2026/475). For the offences of keeper of pig vaccinated against classical swine fever that is slaughtered other than at designated slaughterhouse (Wales ) and keeper of pig vaccinated against classical or African swine fever that is slaughtered other than at designated slaughterhouse (Eng) after this date, see H102734 and H102735.

other.penalty:
Either waySummary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
